Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection. 
which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 
in the title block for inverter (u.p.s) with the following data:
 - AC input: 380v, 50hz, 3ph, AC output: 380v, 23A 50hz, 3ph
 -
 Static By bass 380V, 23A, 50 HZ, 3PH
The first draft initiated by : 
Eng. Abdel Aziz EL Bagoury, tested by eng. Doaa Anis, revised by 
quality control Eeng. Adel Abdel EL Kader EL Nagar at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved by 
eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha PS 2x210 MW
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Caution marks must be hanged on a work place.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set .
Digital voltmeter.
Brush.,
 Blower
Work to be Carried Out
Check for correct operation of DC room air condition.
Check ventilation fan of (UPS).
Read AC input voltage, AC output 
 voltage, AC input current, AC output current, and output rectifier voltage 
 DC and record.
Switch off ( U.P.S ) input and output supply.
Check all abnormal cases inside ( U.P.S ).
Check over heating compartment of rectifier cards, inverter 
 cards, card fram , static switch card and display unit .
Inspect visually fuses, contactors, and capacitors.
Check that the terminals are well tightened and cleaned .
Check that the terminals of input supply switch and output 
 supply switch are tightened
Inspect terminals of battery and keep it clean .
Check that the static by bass of the UPS.
Read battery voltage and test the efficiency of the battery.
Clean UPS from dusty air.
Clean the floor of the DC room.
Put UPS in service and check input and output voltage and 
 record .
